Paul, Hastings, Janofsky & Walker LLP 75East55thStreet New York,NewYork 10022 ASSIGNMENTANDASSUMPTIONOF ZONINGANDDEVELOPMENTRIGHTS THISASSIGNMENTANDASSUMPTIONOFZONINGAND DEVELOPMENT RIGHTS (this “Assignment"), is made and entered into this 3_ day of Ju, 2003 between BERTELSMANN 56TH STREET COMMERCIAL LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, having an office c/o Bertelsmann, Inc., 1540 Broadway, New York, office c/o Jamestown, Two Paces West, Suite 1600, 2727 Paces Ferry Road, Atlanta, Georgia 30339 ("Assignee"). NOW THEREFORE, for Ten Dollars ($10.00), and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties hereto covenant and agree as follows: 1.Assignor hereby assigns to Assignee to the extent applicable, available and transferable, all of Assignor's right, title and interest (if any) in, to and under all zoning and development rights related to that certain condominium office unit located on portions of the sub-cellar, cellar, ground floor, first floor mezzanine, floors 2-26, 26th floor mezzanine and 26th floor mezzanine 2 of that building located at 1731-1737 Broadway, 1739, 1741 Broadway, 1743- 1745 Broadway, and 237-241 West 55th Street, New York, New York 10019, including, without limitation the rights of Assignor (if any) under those agreements described on Schedule A annexed hereto (collectively as the“Zoning Rights"); 2. Assignee hereby expressly assumes the interests, rights, obligations and title of Assignor (if any) in respect of the Zoning Rights accruing from and after the date hereof. 3. This Assignment is made by Assignors without recourse and without any expressed or implied representation or warranty whatsoever (including without limitation, whether Assignor has an interest in the Zoning Rights). 4. This Assignment inures to the benefit of the parties hereto and their respective successors and assigns. 5. Assignor agrees that Assignors will make, execute, acknowledge and deliver all and every such further acts, deeds, conveyances, assignments, notices of assignments, transfers and assurances as Assignee shall from time to time reasonably require, for the better assuring, -1- NY55/288302.1

the Zoning Rights, and the rights hereby conveyed or assigned or intended now, or for carrying recording this Assignment, provided same shall not result in any extra cost or liability to Assignor. [SIGNATUREPAGETOFOLLOW] NY55/288302.1
